description: Defines core classes and structures for the intermediate representation (IR) in the torch::lazy namespace, including Node, OpKind, Output, and Value, with functions for shape and hash management, and external references to other core components.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the IR graph, with methods for shape, operands, hashing, and string conversion.

classes.name: OpKind
classes.description: Encapsulates the operation type associated with a Node, including comparison, hashing, and string conversion.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Represents a specific output of a Node, with hashing and string conversion capabilities.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents an input or operand for a Node, with hashing, shape, and conversion to Output.

methods.name: enableDynamicShape
methods.description: Static method to check if dynamic shapes are enabled.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Method to compute the hash of the node or operation.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the object to a string representation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Stream insertion operator for OpKind and Node.

calls: hash_t OperandHashes(const OpList&, const hash_t&, bool)
